_readme: Variante del CV para la oferta Senior Node.js Engineer de Commit Offshore (djinni 850194). Se fusiona sobre content.json: los objetos se combinan, las listas se sustituyen.

hero.tagline: Senior Node.js engineer · TypeScript · MongoDB · Redis · REST APIs · CI/CD

experience.description: Agri-food traceability startup with its own blockchain (Quadrans). Backend services and the web app that read from the chain. Three concrete contributions:

flowpack.problem: Multi-tenant logistics SaaS (deliveries and pickups) for carriers and agencies. Node.js/TypeScript backend with REST APIs, AI-assisted incident classification, multichannel notifications (WhatsApp, email, webhooks), bulk CSV import, carrier integrations and per-tenant isolation with a security audit.
flowpack.role: Sole architect and developer: system design, backend, frontend, CI/CD with staging and production environments.
flowpack.metric: Production pilot with real logistics-sector clients

pagine.problem: Exchange marketplace for the Italian community with the VAL complementary currency: offer, find and donate products, services and skills. Node.js API and React frontend on MongoDB.
pagine.role: Architect and developer of the whole platform for the client.

chocosfera.problem: Ethical cocoa traceability on blockchain: a Telegram bot lets growers photograph the tree, capture geolocation and issue a tokenized digital certificate; the same channel connects producer and buyer.
chocosfera.metric: Real field data from cocoa growers in Venezuela

facts.v: Building for the web since 2013, self-taught; Web3 from the start.
Solopreneur: architect and developer at once. I know what every technical decision costs in euros and in hours of sleep.
Async and documented by habit, not by mandate. Comfortable in fully remote teams.
